facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: lock out tag out failure on TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on TX-3002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 14 February 2012 an incident occurred on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
